notes.title: Demo Patch: Performance Improvements + Graphics Settings
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new patch is now live for the Timelake: Time Travel Tactics Demo, focusing on performance upgrades and graphics scalability — based directly on your feedback. Huge thanks to everyone who took the time to report issues and share system details.

🔧 Patch Highlights:
[list]
[*]Improved overall FPS and more stable performance during gameplay, especially in complex scenes
[*]Initial visual adjustments made for different screen sizes and quality levels — further tuning is ongoing
[*]Introduced multiple adjustable graphics settings to better support a wide range of hardware setups
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416723/100b77f73a426477300587d17c6186d924961266.jpg[/img]
This is part of ongoing optimization as the demo evolves. More updates are coming — your feedback continues to guide development.

– CatenaryCat

notes.title: A Demo is Coming (Very) Soon!
notes.content:
Hi there time travelers, and welcome to Timelake, a tactical roguelite where time itself is your greatest weapon. 

[h2]What is [color=#FFAC00]Timelake[/color][/h2]
Timelake is a strategy game where you’ll use a unique timeline mechanic to foresee enemy actions and assign moves accordingly. Craft the perfect timeline to defeat your enemies while managing your resources. You can even jump through time to fight alongside your past selves by adding more timelines to the encounter!

Every battle is a puzzle, every timeline is a tool, and every action is part of a bigger plan.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d23EfrE.gif[/img]
[h2][color=#FFAC00]Core[/color] Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Plan Your Time Travel[/b] – Use time jumps to sync up with past versions of yourself. Stack abilities, create combos, and rewrite failure into victory.
[*] [b]Perfect Information[/b] – You can foresee all enemy moves — how will you make the most of it?
[*] [b]Roguelite Progression[/b] – After each encounter, choose your rewards to uncover hidden synergies and master new tactics.
[*] [b]Optimize Resources[/b] – Manage your sand and rubies to overcome your enemies through intricate puzzles and tactics.
[/list]
[h2]A [color=#FFAC00]Demo[/color] is Coming (Very) Soon![/h2]
[color=#FFAC00]We’ll be launching a free demo [b]at the end of this month![/b][/color]

Go hands-on with the time travel mechanics, test your tactical foresight, and experience a slice of the game for yourself. You’ll see how Timelake plays differently from other strategy games, and we encourage you to give us feedback once you play it!

Be sure to wishlist and follow to get notified the moment it drops!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y8s2FTe.gif[/img]
[h2][color=#FFAC00]Follow[/color] Along With Development[/h2]
Timelake is being created by a solo developer alongside a group of talented contributors, and your feedback will help shape its future. 

[b]Get updates, share your thoughts, or discuss the ramifications of messing with time travel:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296330]Wishlist on Steam[/url][/b]: This is the biggest way you can help us succeed and ensures you won’t miss the demo drop and other important updates.
[*] [b][url=https://discord.gg/QDRNpYTKDy]Join the Discord[/url][/b]: Chat with us directly, give feedback, and help shape the game.
[*] [b][url=https://bsky.app/profile/catenarygames.bsky.social]Follow on Bluesky[/url][/b]: For dev updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and announcements.
[/list]
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296330] ✅ Wishlist [color=#FFAC00]Timelake[/color] on Steam[/url][/h2]

We can’t wait to see what kind of timelines you’ll create… and break.

See you in the timelines,
– Catenary Games
